comment:
* Configuration to set API enablement status for site origins through override rules. * *

Websites will follow the default status supplied in the builder constructor, * unless the site origin matches one of the origin patterns supplied in the override rules. * *

The override rules are a map from origin patterns to the desired * {@link WebViewMediaIntegrityApiStatus}.

variables.name: WEBVIEW_MEDIA_INTEGRITY_API_ENABLED
variables.comment:
* Enables the WebView Media Integrity API and allows sharing of the app package name with * the JavaScript caller. * *

This is the default value.

variables.name: WEBVIEW_MEDIA_INTEGRITY_API_ENABLED_WITHOUT_APP_IDENTITY
variables.comment:
* Enables the WebView Media Integrity API for JavaScript callers but disables sharing app
     * package name in generated tokens.

variables.name: WEBVIEW_MEDIA_INTEGRITY_API_DISABLED
variables.comment:
* Disables the WebView Media Integrity API and causes it to return an
     * error code to the JavaScript callers indicating that the app has disabled it.

methods.name: public int getDefaultStatus()
methods.comment: * Returns the default value for origins that don't match any override rules.

methods.name: public Map<String, @WebViewMediaIntegrityApiStatus Integer> getOverrideRules()
methods.comment:
* Get the explicitly set override rules. *

This is a map from origin patterns to their desired WebView Media Integrity API statuses. *
